data.name: LifeDie
data.detailed_description:
This game is only available in Simplified Chinese version.

Story summary:

The amnesiac 'I' woke up in the pitch black forest. Although I don't remember anything, 'I' believe that I should go and accomplish something.

In confusion, a glowing butterfly suddenly appeared. Follow the guidance of the butterfly and gradually understand this forest.

This is a world bound by the diary of a young girl named Liuling. Reads Liuling's diary and constantly delves into the forest.

The story written by Liuling overlaps with 'I', and she tries to find the meaning of life.

So "I" and "Butterfly" touched on the story of Liuling and explored the meaning of life together.

Game Introduction:

Players play as the amnesiac 'I' in the game, and upon waking up, they encounter a glowing butterfly.

The main plot of the story is the diary of a girl named Liuling, who continuously advances the game process by collecting her diary.

The process of the game alternates between reading stories and passing levels.

In the process of advancing the process, 'I' will encounter items possessed by glowing butterflies, converse with them, complete designated tasks, and collect these glowing butterflies.

Butterflies have magical powers, and after collecting them, they can use corresponding abilities.

The abilities that butterflies can provide include mechanisms such as backpacks and maps; Or weapons, special skills, and other abilities that can help you pass levels.

The levels encountered in the game process include puzzle solving and interacting with monsters.

The puzzle levels need to be completed based on the given prompts and their association with the plot, including answering questions, performing specified actions, operating mechanisms in the scene, and finding specific items to place in specific locations.

In the levels where monsters interact, some require dodging their attacks and advancing, while others require using weapons to eliminate the monsters.

Notes:

This game revolves around the plot and has a text volume of approximately 50000 words.

Linear process, with selected branch but incorrect options only leading to failure (and returning to the selected branch)

The level has a certain level of operational difficulty, and if successful, it can be completed within 4-5 hours.

Emphasize thinking and strategy, even in battles with monsters, it is still recommended to think about strategies to deal with enemies before taking action.

Provide simple modes for players who are struggling with certain combat levels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: There is content describing self harming behavior in this game, please do not imitate the dangerous behavior of characters in the game.
